title: Echoes of Origins: default event set
assumptions: Two declared scenario events (an uncertain target illumination during approach and a solar particle event during science) occur on days drawn from independent seeded scenario streams; they are the only random element of the run.
The scenario events are illustrative narrative, not a space-weather or photometry forecast.

scenarioEvents.title: Solar particle event: safe-mode prompt
scenarioEvents.situation: A solar particle event raises the radiation dose and the risk of memory upsets in the onboard buffer.
scenarioEvents.prompt: Enter safe mode or keep the science timeline running?
scenarioEvents.counterfactual: Schedule observations with slack so a safe-mode pause does not remove a required measurement, and downlink often so little data is exposed in the buffer.

choices.label: Enter safe mode (pause science)
choices.tradeoff: No risk to the spacecraft or its data, but observations in the next 10 days are not flown.

choices.label: Continue science
choices.tradeoff: No science time lost, but upsets corrupt half of the buffered data and the heaters drain 25 % of the battery.

scenarioEvents.title: Uncertain target illumination
scenarioEvents.situation: Approach imaging shows the target is darker than the pre-launch scenario estimate, so each observation collects less usable signal per hour.
scenarioEvents.prompt: Extend the observations or keep the planned schedule?
scenarioEvents.counterfactual: Plan observation time with margin over each requirement so an illumination surprise does not leave a measurement short.

choices.label: Keep the planned schedule
choices.tradeoff: No extra data volume or propellant; measurements keep their planned observation time.

choices.label: Extend the observations
choices.tradeoff: Observations run at 1.5x their duty cycle (more scheduled time and collected data), but the buffer fills faster and the extra attitude work uses 3 % of the propellant.
